channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Roger Goodell and NFL make weak, cautious statements on Steve Tisch’s Jeffrey Epstein emails
item.description: Eventually, Goodell admitted he was concerned about how this can reflect on the NFL

item.title: Roger Goodell: NFL chose Bad Bunny to ‘unite people,’ wants ‘safe’ Super Bowl amid ICE fears
item.description: Bad Bunny, who was born in Puerto Rico, has publicly opposed Trump and his policies before.

item.title: Security guard for NYC Health and Hospitals arrested for obstructing NYPD at Brooklyn psych ward
item.description: Private security guard Kadeem Alfred, 32, and NYCHH police supervisor Michael Kee, 53, were arrested after the guard refused to let NYPD officers responding to a call for backup into the psych ward at Kings County Hospital.

item.title: Brendan Banfield found guilty in ‘au pair’ double murder
item.description: Brendan Banfield, a former IRS agent accused of conspiring with his child's au pair to murder his wife and frame another man, has been found guilty.

item.title: Trump’s $200 million Kennedy Center makeover to use ‘highest-grade everything’
item.description: President Trump estimates renovating the Kennedy Center will cost $200M, take two years and use "highest-grade everything."

item.title: Man arrested for stealing car in Queens with 72-year-old man in backseat
item.description: The victim was waiting in the backseat of an idling 2016 Subaru in Long Island City when the thief jumped in the driver's seat and sped off on Jan. 17, police said.

item.title: Gateway Development Commission sues Trump for breach of contract over Hudson River Tunnel cash
item.description: The Gateway Development Commission sued the federal government late Monday, after months of the Trump administration's refusal to distribute money approved by Congress for the construction of the Hudson River Tunnel.

item.title: Fox News host thinks Melania Trump should win an Oscar for ‘Melania’ movie
item.description: Fox News host Kayleigh McEnany thinks Melania Trump should win an Academy Award for the part in the documentary "Melania."

item.title: Deli worker fights off armed robbers at UWS bodega
item.description: A lion-hearted deli worker fought off two armed robbers posing as cops inside an Upper West Side bodega Monday night -- and it wasn't even his second month on the job.

item.title: Asking Eric: Without public weigh-ins, weight-loss motivation falters
item.description: Dear Eric: Like many people, my weight yo-yos. Over the decades, I have joined many weight-loss programs and got to my target weight on each (with 100 pounds being the most loss at one time).
